definitions.explanation: A statement of disagreement or opposition.
Something that is different or unusual.

examples.japanese: {異|い}を{挟|はさ}む{余地|よち}はない。
examples.english: There is no room for objection.

notes:
{異|い} means objection or difference.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {異|い}を{唱|とな}える (to raise an objection)
- {異|い}を{挟|はさ}む (to object)
- {異|い}なし (no objection)
- {異|い}{存|ぞん}ない (no objection - formal)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {異常|いじょう}: abnormal
- {異動|いどう}: personnel transfer
- {異議|いぎ}: objection, protest
- {異国|いこく}: foreign country
